launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Kaya is the _only_ company that provides end-to-end campaign management services and a marketing analytics platform. With our cutting-edge AI and experienced marketers, we deliver your campaigns 10x cheaper, better, and faster than traditional agencies or freelancers.

### **🧨 Problem**

Startups need paid ads to grow, but building a full-stack marketing function takes years and significant funding. Most companies end up hiring traditional agencies, freelancers, or in-house teams and face these problems:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82580&key=user_uploads/719782/92924144-4967-4efa-a7ad-83bd60a9e10f)

### **✅ Our Solution**

Kaya delivers a seasoned team and marketing analytics from the get-go, saving you significant time and money.

* **Campaign management services:** We launch and optimize your marketing campaigns across multiple channels (Google, LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok Ads).

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82580&key=user_uploads/719782/3f54641a-8033-4bf5-8a0d-cd7214991d2e)

* **Marketing analytics platform:** Customized dashboard and Slack bot to track CAC and all marketing KPIs.
* Slack channel with Kaya’s founders and marketers for seamless collaboration.

# 

### **💖 Why Founders Love Us**

* **Results**: See campaigns launched in 2 weeks and performance improvements within 1 month.
* **Speed:** Our internal tools utilize data science and AI to optimize campaign performance. Our SLA is 1-3 days, depending on task complexity.
* **Work quality:** Despite using AI in our workflow, our experienced marketers further amend and ensure everything is of top-notch quality. We also provide unlimited revisions.
* **Pricing:** Our technology enables us to deliver better results with minimal overhead costs, and we pass those savings back to you.
* **Cultural fit:** We're a startup ourselves, so we prioritize experimenting in a structured way and working iteratively.

...and more. [**Read testimonials →**](https://www.usekaya.com/reviews?utm_medium=referral&utm_source=yc&utm_campaign=launch-yc-ads-management-service)

# 

### **🚀 Interested?**

Tell us your marketing goals and get a tailored marketing plan featuring:

* Practical paid ads strategy and sample ad copies
* Insights about competitor paid ads you can’t find anywhere else
* CAC forecast

[**Get a free proposal here →**](https://app.usekaya.com/start?utm_medium=referral&utm_source=yc&utm_campaign=launch-yc-ads-management-service)

### 🤗 **Our team**

Hi everyone, we’re Brian and Jee– the team behind [Kaya](https://www.usekaya.com/?utm_medium=referral&utm_source=yc&utm_campaign=launch-yc-ads-management-service).

At Kaya, we've built our team and services with founders in mind. We initially started with a SaaS product and quickly learned that most marketing tools are designed for experienced marketers, not busy entrepreneurs. We also realized that founders generally want two things: quick implementation and solid results. So we've created a service that delivers both. Our team provides comprehensive marketing support, from strategy to execution, backed by AI and data analytics. Our approach typically results in significantly better ROI compared to traditional methods, helping your startup grow faster without the usual marketing headaches.
